mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2013 or newer) or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or Apple M1 integrated GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (2015 or newer) or Apple M1/M2
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU or Apple M2+ integrated GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

name: Dragons Brew Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Runs best at 720p or 1080p. Integrated graphics supported.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950 / AMD Radeon R7 370 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster load times.
